title: Long lines for transportation thing at mallworld ?
content: So I have been in a huuuge high ceilings white lobby and there is a longggggg line of people waiting to go on a best I can explain it as a single person tube transportation thats on almost like train tracks and it takes off at lightening speeds. Anyways I dont even know why I did this, but I *cut* in line and basically passed everyone all the way to the front of lne and this young guy who i jumped in front of was MAD as hell and started to get others upset too saying I cut the line.. but for whatever reason I cant remember why but I couldn't wait on this line and when I got in the tube thing, I woke up. Has anyone experienced this???? Where did the transport thing take you to? ?
